content.title: Refine Homes results with Filters after homepage search
content.intent: Prove the results page exposes Filters and updates results after a filter is applied.
content.technique_notes: Reused existing scenario coverage instead of minting a duplicate because an identical fresh scenario already exists. Techniques: pagination/search-list filtering profile for results refinement; state_flow because the path starts from routed search results. Risk-judged interaction strength = 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss promise applies. No budget ceiling was set, so this path was kept.
